node.title: Re: Bug in eval in pre-5.28
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
On pre-5.14 Perls, this is a bug.

I just wanted to mention that some of the known remaining bugs ([id://1219121|1], [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/issues/14473#issuecomment-544067065|2], [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/issues/14487#issuecomment-544067329|3]) weren't fixed until v5.28. Basically, at this point, I would never recommend eval { ... }; if ($@) { ... }.

my $success = eval { ...; 1 }; is The Right Way To Do It.* And remember that $@ could still be a [id://11104607|false] value.

* TIMTOWTDI still applies: eval { ...; 1 } or do { ... };, unless ( eval { ...; 1 } ) { ... }, my $ok = eval { ...; 1 }; if (!$ok) { ... }, and so on.
